description: Required status checks for master branch protection on OpenShift-Fleet/rehor

github_actions.name: format
github_actions.note: path-filtered to **.py, pyproject.toml, uv.lock. not a hard branch protection requirement.

github_actions.name: test
github_actions.scope: python unit tests with coverage gate
github_actions.note: path-filtered. job name collides across ruff-format.yml, go-tests.yml, dashboard-tests.yml, and memory-server-ci.yml.

github_actions.name: go-audit
github_actions.note: path-filtered to proxy/executor/go.mod, go.sum. currently report-only for findings.

github_actions.name: node-audit
github_actions.note: path-filtered to dashboard/package-lock.json. currently report-only for findings.

github_actions.name: verify-bot
github_actions.scope: bot container image build + required-tooling presence check (REHOR-107)
github_actions.note: path-filtered to bot image inputs (Dockerfile, entrypoint.sh, bot/**, presets/**, etc). does not run the real entrypoint — see docs/operations/rehor-107-container-verification.md

github_actions.name: verify-proxy
github_actions.scope: proxy container image build + squid/executor-socket smoke check (REHOR-107)

github_actions.name: verify-memory-server
github_actions.scope: memory-server container image build + /health smoke check against pgvector (REHOR-107)

github_actions.name: e2e-minimal
github_actions.scope: multi-container runtime startup + entrypoint validation harness (REHOR-62)
github_actions.note: path-filtered to runtime/container harness inputs. full-stack fixture currently manual via workflow_dispatch.

konflux.name: Red Hat Konflux / platform-frontend-ai-dev-on-pull-request
konflux.scope: main bot container build and integration pipeline
konflux.note: runs on every PR (no path filter)

konflux.name: Red Hat Konflux / platform-frontend-ai-dev-memory-server-on-pull-request
konflux.note: runs on every PR (no path filter)

konflux.name: Red Hat Konflux / platform-frontend-ai-dev-proxy-on-pull-request
konflux.note: path-filtered to proxy/** changes only; cannot be a hard required check

konflux_enterprise_contract.name: Red Hat Konflux / platform-frontend-ai-dev-enterprise-contract / pr group
konflux_enterprise_contract.note: reports as 'skipping' on most PRs; only runs when EC policy triggers. staged for future required status.

path_scoping_notes.description: All GitHub Actions workflows use path filters. Only the main bot and memory-server Konflux pipelines run on every PR (no path filter in CEL expression). The proxy Konflux pipeline is path-filtered to proxy/** changes.
path_scoping_notes.required_in_branch_protection: Only checks that fire on EVERY PR can be hard-required in branch protection. Currently that is the two non-path-filtered Konflux build checks. Path-filtered checks (all GitHub Actions + proxy Konflux) are trusted to pass when they fire, but not enforced as branch protection gates.
path_scoping_notes.future: If a lightweight always-running gate workflow is added (e.g. a status-aggregator that reports success/neutral for path-filtered checks that didn't fire), more checks can be promoted to required.
